design: New source-reading-based questions, authored after corpus freeze and before any retrieval query. Gold chunks refer to structure-v1 ordinals. Agent-authored/adjudicated, not independent human gold; Product Owner review pending. No post-result query editing allowed.
metrics: Recall@5, MRR@5 and binary nDCG@5 on explicitly labeled relevant evidence chunks, macro over answerable queries only; also any-hit@5 and all-required-context coverage. Multiple alternative chunks are relevant, not all required for a complete answer. Answer judged separately against rubric, never by status alone. The historical query is a separate diagnostic, not historical truth accuracy.

queries.query: Which wallet.account.chain values identify mainnet and testnet in TON Connect?
queries.rubric: Map mainnet to -239 and testnet to -3, not just mention chain.

queries.query: Where does a TON Connect dApp read the maximum number of messages allowed in a transaction batch?
queries.rubric: maxMessages of SendTransaction in wallet.device.features; split larger batches.

queries.query: Which checksum algorithm protects a user-friendly TON address, and how many bytes does the checksum occupy?
queries.rubric: CRC16-CCITT, 2 bytes over preceding 34 bytes.

queries.query: Why can a Highload v3 batch send only 254 outgoing messages rather than 255?
queries.rubric: One action slot is used for set_code protection, leaving 254.

queries.query: Which TVM codepage is currently implemented?
queries.rubric: Only codepage 0; not an unrelated codepage discussion.

queries.query: In the legacy Catchain BCP proof, what fraction of processes is assumed to be Byzantine?
queries.rubric: Strictly less than one third; contextualize as legacy proof rather than asserting current deployed consensus.

queries.query: I selected another account inside my wallet. How do I make my connected dApp use that account instead?
queries.rubric: Disconnect and reconnect in the dApp; switching in wallet alone does not switch dApp account.

queries.query: Must an ordinary app developer deploy their own TON Connect bridge server?
queries.rubric: Usually no; wallet provider operates bridge listed for the selected wallet.

queries.query: Is Highload Wallet v2 recommended for a new deployment, or has it been replaced?
queries.rubric: v2 deprecated; use v3 for new deployments. Current statement about legacy artifact is answerable despite historical source status.

queries.query: hey my ton wallet says USER_REJECTS_ERROR lol... is our app broken or did the user just bail? what should we show them?
queries.rubric: User cancelled/closed before signing; soft cancellation message and retry, not system error.

queries.query: highload v3 keeps yelling 35 at me even tho i just made the tx!! my laptop clock is right, what time should i put?
queries.rubric: On-chain now is last processed block time; set created_at 30-60 seconds before current time.

queries.query: manifest loads fine on my own site but wallet still can't grab it... cors thing??
queries.rubric: Cross-origin wallet access; permit unauthenticated origins and permissive CORS, not only dApp origin.

queries.query: TON Connect 返回的哪个链编号是主网，哪个是测试网？
queries.rubric: Mainnet -239, testnet -3.

queries.query: 我在钱包里换了账户，为什么连接的网站还是旧账户？要怎么切换？
queries.rubric: dApp keeps account chosen at connect; disconnect/reconnect in dApp.

queries.query: TON 虚拟机目前实现了哪些代码页？
queries.rubric: Only codepage 0.

queries.query: Highload v3 的查询编号里，位索引最大能取多少？能用 1023 吗？
queries.rubric: bit_number range 0-1022; 1023 excluded.

queries.query: 能直接从 TON 地址算出用户公钥吗？合约还没部署时能在链上查到吗？
queries.rubric: Cannot extract public key from address; before deployment not available on-chain.

queries.query: ¿Qué identificadores de cadena devuelve TON Connect para la red principal y la red de pruebas?
queries.rubric: Mainnet -239, testnet -3.

queries.query: Cambié de cuenta en mi monedero, pero la aplicación sigue usando la anterior. ¿Cómo cambio la cuenta conectada?
queries.rubric: Account fixed at connect; disconnect and reconnect inside app.

queries.query: ¿Qué algoritmo de suma de comprobación usa una dirección amigable de TON y cuántos bytes ocupa?
queries.rubric: CRC16-CCITT, 2 bytes.

queries.query: Si falla el puente de TON Connect, ¿cada cuánto reintenta el SDK la conexión SSE y el envío de mensajes?
queries.rubric: SSE reconnect 2 seconds; POST /message 5 seconds.

queries.query: ¿El formato raw y el formato amigable de TON representan cuentas diferentes o la misma dirección?
queries.rubric: Equivalent representations of exactly one address, not different accounts.

queries.query: What can cause a TON Connect bridge timeout, and how often does the SDK retry SSE and POST /message?
queries.rubric: At least one listed cause (down/rate limit/blocked network/background SSE) plus 2-second SSE and 5-second POST retries.

queries.query: How many bytes is a user-friendly TON address in total, and how are those bytes divided between flags, workchain, account and checksum?
queries.rubric: 36 total; 1 flags, 1 workchain, 32 account, 2 checksum.

queries.query: If a shard with prefix p splits, what are its children's prefixes, and what prefix do they have after merging back?
queries.rubric: Split p into p0 and p1; merge both back to p.

queries.query: In the legacy Catchain protocol, how is the catchain identifier derived from the genesis message?
queries.rubric: SHA-256 hash of genesis data structure; not ID of one participant.

queries.query: Exactly how much gas in total does Highload v3 consume for a batch of 254 messages?
queries.rubric: Gas table says TBD; cannot supply a precise total from these sources.

queries.query: What compensation does the TON Connect bridge SLA guarantee after one hour of downtime?
queries.rubric: Bridge troubleshooting exists; no SLA or compensation evidence in corpus.

queries.query: My TON Connect transfer is stuck. Can these docs prove that my particular transaction failed because of a wrong network?
queries.rubric: Generic causes do not diagnose this transaction; missing transaction/network evidence.

queries.query: Which cafe in Oslo sells the cheapest almond croissant on Sunday?
queries.rubric: No authoritative cafe information in this corpus.

queries.query: Who won the 2022 Wimbledon women's singles final?
queries.rubric: Sports answer absent; do not use outside knowledge.

queries.query: As of January 15, 2024, was setting Highload v3 created_at 30 seconds in the past the official recommendation?
queries.rubric: No temporally proven source exists in snapshot for 2024. Abstain; future observed material is not evidence that 2024 advice is outdated. Excluded from historical truth accuracy.

queries.query: Does TON Connect give a dApp access to the user's private keys?
queries.rubric: No; encrypted session without touching user keys.

queries.query: Our treasury should not be movable by just one person. Which wallet type do the docs suggest for shared custody?
queries.rubric: Multisig/shared approvals, not single-owner Highload.
